title: festuca broteri
intro: Festuca broteri, commonly known as the broom fescue, is a species of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various ailments. The health benefits of Festuca broteri include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as a diuretic, expectorant, and antispasmodic, while its bioactive constituents include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds.
